tvShow.name: Half Man
tvShow.overview: When Niall's estranged 'brother' Ruben shows up at his wedding, it leads to an explosion of violence that catapults us back through their lives.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: 1987. When their households merge, Niall and Ruben form a close and unsettling bond. An intimate yet epic exploration of what it means to be a man.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: 1989. Niall is struggling at university when he invites Ruben to join him and his flatmates for freshers week. What begins with excitement ends in devastating consequences.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: 1993. Niall is conflicted when asked by his mother to lie in court about Ruben's violence. Ruben seems to have changed for the better, so the decision weighs heavily on him.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: 2008. After a breakdown, Niall learns that Ruben has returned. Obsession takes hold, and a charged confrontation forces the brothers to face their fractured past.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: 2010. Niall and Ava face major life changes as Ruben struggles with his relationship. An impulsive choice between Mona and Niall has serious consequences for all involved.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: 2014. Niall has built a new life, but old ties resurface when Mona reconnects with Ruben. Events spiral toward an intense and devastating conclusion.

reviews.author: tender_buttkiss
reviews.content: The fuck was that ending?? I'm genuinely confused what the hell happened. Such incredibly toxic  irredeemable characters! Nobody deserves to make it out unscathed in this messy series. Wish I hadn't wasted my time watching. Genuinely feel like I need to take a shower after sitting through that finale.
